P1.rule: Every stack contains at least one yellow object.

P2.rule: Every large square has a small object resting directly on top of it.

P3.rule: No large object rests directly on a small object.

P4.rule: Every triangle is in a stack to the right of every circle.

P5.rule: There is at least one large yellow object.

P6.rule: There are more red objects than blue objects.

P7.rule: The total number of objects in the scene is odd.

P8.rule: Every triangle rests directly on a blue square.
